import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if w <= 3:
        print("YES")
        return
    if m < 0:
        print("NO")
        return
    bases = []
    v = 1
    while v <= 2000000000:
        bases.append(v)
        v *= w
    n = len(bases)
    digits = [0] * n
    cur_total = -sum(bases)
    works = False
    outer_break = False
    while not outer_break and not works:
        index = 0
        while True:
            digits[index] += 1
            cur_total += bases[index]
            if digits[index] != 3:
                if abs(cur_total) == m:
                    works = True
                break
            digits[index] = 0
            cur_total -= bases[index] * 3
            index += 1
            if index == n:
                outer_break = True
                break
    print("YES" if works else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
